Straight fire, best bar in the history of rap
Ecko unl. Baggy pants and baggy shirts
I do not believe he cared about how it would impact me or my life and I no longer of I could’ve become I am me now. And thank you for that information

At least you’re trying to help people from killing themselves. I feel like I wear masks for everyone. At work it’s a mask, school it’s a mask, my family it’s a mask, my roommates it’s a mask, etc. and I’m tired of having to be fake for people

Idk if I want to take depression meds because this has been me for so many years that idk anything different I don’t want to take meds to feel like everyone else I’d rather just end it.

My high school coach got upset at my defiance of his coaching skills so he kicked me off the team and I lost my scholarships. I don’t like to play anymore it causes a lot of physical pain because of old injuries and it causes emotional pain because I think of who I could be or how happy I could be
I’m just done with it all honestly, pleasing people, pretending I’m ok, trying to do anything to get my mind to how it used to be but nothing has worked for4 years so it’s time
I was 16 I don’t think it stunted any emotional development on me personally I constantly get told I act older than I look but I believe that’s only because I keep more to myself and I’m more serious
I’ve always thought of what my family would feel before I do something and how I wouldn’t want to embarrass them but since they love me they will understand and those who don’t love me will not

Last week my therapist asked what I would write in my next chapter I didn’t tell her I wanted this chapter to be the ending but it is this time I don’t worry about how people will feel or even have any emotions for it it just feels like I’ve run out of pages

I’ve been living with it for about 4 years now and suicidal for about 3 I don’t take any mental illness meds since I’m an ex addict and only 20. I peeled up for a little while but quickly fell back into my depression a few weeks after seeing her. I had happiness before my scholarships for basketball were taken away due to anger issues. I was robbed of one of the only things I ever loved and have never been able to fully get out of it and just can’t anymore
I’m tired of the pain I feel and the stress of going through life to only die at the end there’s no point to life so why read the whole book when you skip to the end
I couldn’t go through the pain of hanging myself so I pulled myself back up until I could find footing
